$comment: NebulaOS workspace control - project settings. DERIVED STATE.
Canonical source: NebulaOS-firmware/tools/workspace-control/claude/settings.json
Do not hand-edit the installed copy at .claude/settings.json; the identity gate
detects drift. Edit canonical, then run tools/sync-workspace-control.sh --apply.
Archive isolation is defence in depth:
1. Read(...)  deny  - Claude Code applies Read rules to ALL file-reading tools
(Read, Glob, Grep), so separate Glob/Grep rules are
rejected as unmatched and are deliberately absent.
2. Edit(...)  deny  - likewise covers ALL file-editing tools (Edit, Write,
NotebookEdit); a separate Write rule is rejected.
3. Bash(cd:*) deny  - blocks shell cd into the archive.
4. sandbox.filesystem.denyRead/denyWrite - OS-level boundary that also stops
cat/head/python open()/relative paths/symlinks.
5. PreToolUse hook  - denies any tool input mentioning NebulaOS-archive and
explains why.
Subagents inherit all of it; no project subagent is granted an exception.
NOTE: this Claude Code build has no SlashCommand/cd permission tool, so the
/cd slash command cannot be gated by a permission rule. It is covered instead
by the empty additionalDirectories (the archive is not a permitted working
directory) plus layers 4 and 5, which fail regardless of the working directory.
sandbox.autoAllowBashIfSandboxed defaults to TRUE in this build; it is pinned
false on purpose. The sandbox is an OS filesystem boundary around the archive,
not a reason to auto-approve shell commands.
